q-0340.answer:
Surah Hud (11) — Hud · 123 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• This is a severe threat for whoever turns away from the commandments of Allah, the Exalted, and rejects His Messengers.
• Alif, Lam, Ra. [This is] a Book whose verses are perfected and then presented in detail from [one who is] Wise and Acquainted.
• [Through a messenger, saying], "Do not worship except Allah. Indeed, I am to you from Him a warner and a bringer of good tidings,"
• And [saying], "Seek forgiveness of your Lord and repent to Him, [and] He will let you enjoy a good provision for a specified term and give every doer of favor his favor. But if you turn away, then indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a great Day.
• And to Thamud [We sent] their brother Salih. He said, "O my people, worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him. He has produced you from the earth and settled you in it, so ask forgiveness of Him and then repent to Him. Indeed, my Lord is near and responsive."

q-0502.answer: Scholars classify the 114 surahs by where they were first revealed: approximately **86 surahs are Meccan** (revealed before Hijrah in Makkah) and **28 are Medinan** (revealed after Hijrah in Madinah). Meccan surahs often focus on faith, tawhid, and the Hereafter; Medinan surahs often address law, community, and governance. Individual surah pages show each surah's revelation type.

Surah Al-Alaq (96) — The Clot · 19 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• `indeed We will make it extremely black on the Day of Judgement.
• `unto Allah is the final destination and return, and He will hold you accountable for your wealth, as to where you obtained it from and how did you spend it.
• `O Muhammad! Do not obey him in what he is forbidding from such as steadfastness in worship and performing worship in abundance.
• His people and his tribe. In other words, let him call them in order to seek help from them.

Surah Al-Kaafiroon (109) — The Disbelievers · 6 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• I do not worship according to your worship, which means that I do not go along with it or follow it.
• You do not follow the commands of Allah and His Legislation in His worship.
• Say, "O disbelievers,
• I do not worship what you worship.
• Nor are you worshippers of what I worship.

q-5839.answer:
Quran 42:35 — Ash-Shura (Consultation)

وَيَعْلَمَ ٱلَّذِينَ يُجَٰدِلُونَ فِىٓ ءَايَٰتِنَا مَا لَهُم مِّن مَّحِيصٍۢ

Transliteration: Wa ya'lamal lazeena yujaadiloona feee Aayaatinaa maa lahum mim mahees

Translation: And [that is so] those who dispute concerning Our signs may know that for them there is no place of escape.

q-5941.answer:
Quran 48:4 — Al-Fath (The Victory)

هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلَ ٱلسَّكِينَةَ فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ لِيَزْدَادُوٓا۟ إِيمَٰنًۭا مَّعَ إِيمَٰنِهِمْ ۗ وَلِلَّهِ جُنُودُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًۭا

Transliteration: Huwal lazeee anzalas sakeenata fee quloobil mu'mineena liyazdaadooo eemaanamma'a eemaanihim; wa lillaahi junoodus samawaati wal ard; wa kaanal laahu 'Aleeman Hakeemaa

Translation: It is He who sent down tranquillity into the hearts of the believers that they would increase in faith along with their [present] faith. And to Allah belong the soldiers of the heavens and the earth, and ever is Allah Knowing and Wise.
